workerResult.summary: GHOST GRID: a swiss-styled collaborative pixel haunt. A 48x36 canvas where you paint/erase with a red-black-white-blue ink palette, smooth line interpolation on drag, high-DPI rendering, undo/clear, live pixel + room stats in the masthead, crisp PNG export, and a share link that run-length-encodes the entire grid into a self-contained ?g= URL fragment (round-trip verified: 5 px packed, loaded, restored). Scroll reactivity drives a red rail indicator, canvas skew, and a warming-to-red background atmosphere with a deep-scroll zoom mode; the Konami code (? up up down down left right left right B A ?) wakes a ghost that flickers phantom red pixels across the grid. Swiss identity: hard grid, system Helvetica/Arial, black-and-paper palette with a single screaming red, 2px hairlines, and a compact control rail that collapses into a scrollable stacked sheet under 760px. Verified clean at 375px and desktop with zero console errors and no horizontal overflow.
